standard.summary: 特征提取跑在 CPU 还是 GPU。cpu 不占显存但更慢，cuda 更快但会和大模型抢显存。
standard.effect: 只影响打分阶段的设备；训练本身仍在主设备上跑。
standard.whenToUse: 显存吃紧或数据集不大时用 cpu；数据集很大、显存有余量时用 cuda。
standard.avoidWhen: 显存已经贴着上限时不要用 cuda——打分和模型加载会同时争抢，更容易 OOM。

optionDescriptions.cpu: 不占显存，速度取决于 CPU 核数与图片数量。
optionDescriptions.cuda: 走 GPU 前向，快很多，但要和主模型分显存。

standard_en.summary: Whether feature extraction runs on CPU or GPU. cpu costs no VRAM but is slower; cuda is much faster but competes with the model for VRAM.
standard_en.effect: It only affects the scoring stage; training itself still runs on the main device.
standard_en.whenToUse: Use cpu when VRAM is tight or the dataset is small; use cuda for a large dataset with headroom.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not use cuda when VRAM is already near the ceiling -- scoring and model loading then compete and OOM sooner.

optionDescriptions.cpu: No VRAM cost; speed depends on CPU cores and image count.
optionDescriptions.cuda: GPU forward passes, much faster, but shares VRAM with the main model.

advanced.principle: settings 把 likeness_device 原样带进 embedder 运行配置，打分阶段据此选设备；look_filter_preparation 的日志会把实际设备打出来，方便对照启动耗时。
advanced.intervention: 只改打分阶段的设备选择，不触碰训练设备与精度。
advanced.expectedImpact: cuda 通常把打分从分钟级压到秒级，具体取决于模型与图片数量。
advanced.tradeoffs: 设备字符串不做严格校验，写错会在打分时才暴露；cpu / cuda 之外不要填别的。

advanced_en.principle: settings carries likeness_device straight into the embedder runtime config, and the scoring stage selects its device from it; look_filter_preparation logs the device it actually used so startup cost can be compared.
advanced_en.intervention: Changes only the scoring stage's device choice, never the training device or precision.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: cuda typically takes scoring from minutes to seconds, depending on the model and image count.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The device string is not strictly validated, so a typo only surfaces at scoring time; use nothing other than cpu / cuda.
